title: Senior Software Engineer (Capture)
desc:
Who We Are 
 Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:
 Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
 Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
 Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.
 Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.
 Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.
 Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.
 What you’ll do
 As a Senior Software Engineer on the Capture team, you will design, build, and operate the distributed services that form Pindrop's real-time ingestion layer. You will engineer systems that acquire, normalize, and deliver real-time and recorded audio, video, and telephony metadata across provider platforms (Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Google Meet, Amazon Connect, Genesys) into Pindrop’s downstream analytics, fraud detection, and authentication engines.This is a product-engineering role focused on real-time media ingestion, low-latency streaming pipelines, provider integrations, and production reliability. It is not an ML model-development or model-scoring role.
 More specifically, you will: 
 Design, build, test, deploy, and operate distributed Go microservices and media pipelines optimized for low-latency processing, high availability, and fault tolerance.
 Build and evolve integrations across communication technologies and protocols, including SIPREC, RTP, WebRTC, WebSockets, and enterprise contact center platforms.
 Lead projects from architecture and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
 Diagnose complex distributed systems issues using logs, metrics, traces, and system tests; improve service reliability, capacity, and security.
 Provide technical guidance through design reviews, code reviews, architecture decisions, and mentoring junior engineers.
 Partner closely with Product, System Test, Infrastructure, SRE, and adjacent analytics teams to deliver seamless data ingestion.
 Participate in a shared on-call rotation after completing team training and production-readiness onboarding.
 Who you are
 Resilient & Adaptable: You are optimistic in the face of ambiguity and change, turning complex engineering challenges into scalable solutions.
 Accountable Owner: You take end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, under-promising and over-delivering on commitments.
 Analytical Problem Solver: You possess strong analytical skills and enjoy driving technical design, project leadership, and mentorship.
 Clear Communicator: You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to cross-functional partners and make decisions understandable across teams.
 Your skill-set
 Must Have 
 5+ years of professional software development experience building and operating distributed backend services in production.
 Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or a comparable compiled language, with strong Linux/Unix, networking, concurrency, and performance tuning fundamentals.
 Hands-on experience with cloud-native architectures (AWS/GCP), containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and DevOps practices (Terraform/CDK, CI/CD pipelines).

title: Staff Software Engineer, Compute and Network
desc:
Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.
 Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.
 With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in Deloitte’s Fast 500 (four years running!), LinkedIn’s Top Startups , Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!), Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !
 About the Role 
 The Staff Software Engineer on the platform team will help set the technical direction for the compute and networking platform that underpins Attentive’s microservices architecture. The role involves building reusable cloud components, clear interfaces, and self-service tools that make infrastructure easier to use and safer to operate.
 This hands-on technical leadership role drives measurable improvements in platform reliability, cost efficiency and developer productivity. Responsibilities span identifying shared needs across teams, setting architectural direction, and leading complex initiatives from problem definition through production operation, balancing delivery speed with security and long-term maintainability
 The platform runs on AWS and uses Kubernetes, Istio, Argo CD, Terraform, and Cloudflare at the edge.
 What You’ll Accomplish 
 Shape the technical direction and architecture of Attentive’s platform as part of the compute and networking team, partnering with engineering leaders to prioritize investments.
 Partner closely with engineering teams to understand their workflows and pain points, and build platform software, APIs, and self-service tools that reduce friction and help them deliver reliable services faster.
 Lead complex initiatives across teams, turning ambiguous requirements into designs, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
 Evolve Kubernetes and networking infrastructure across multiple AWS accounts and networks to support growth, resilience, and efficient resource use.
 Own and improve Infrastructure-as-Code orchestration and reusable cloud components, providing consistent interfaces and guardrails for consuming AWS services.
 Diagnose complex production issues and drive lasting improvements to system design, observability, and operational practices.
 Improve platform reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency while reducing operational overhead for the platform team and its users.
 Raise the engineering bar through hands-on development, design and code reviews, mentorship, and technical guidance.
 Identify and establish effective AI-assisted engineering practices across the team, improving productivity while maintaining code quality, security, and operational reliability.
 Your Expertise 
 Significant experience designing, building, and operating large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems, with demonstrated technical leadership across teams.
 Strong software engineering background, including building maintainable software, tooling, or APIs that solve infrastructure problems.
